| # Supported UDS Services for Customer Instance {#supported-uds-services-for-customer-instance-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                  |                                                                                                                                                           |
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

 

  --------------------------------- --------------------------- ------------------------------------------------------------------ ----------------------------- -----------------------------
  Diagnostic Services               Service Identifier Number   Configuration changeable from easyConfig                           Supported for BODAS-service   Supported for Customer Tool
  DiagnosticSessionControl          0x10                        no, pre-configured                                                 yes                           yes
  ECUReset                          0x11                        yes                                                                yes                           yes
  SecurityAccess                    0x27                        yes (seed&key callback fixed by BSW, see Security Access Levels)   yes                           yes
  CommunicationControl              0x28                        yes                                                                yes                           yes
  TesterPresent                     0x3E                        no                                                                 yes                           yes
  ControlDTCSetting                 0x85                        yes                                                                yes                           yes
  ReadDataByIdentifier              0x22                        no                                                                 yes                           yes
  DynamicallyDefineDataIdentifier   0x2C                        no                                                                 yes                           yes
  WriteDataByIdentifier             0x2E                        no                                                                 yes                           yes
  ClearDiagnosticInformation        0x14                        yes                                                                yes                           yes
  ReadDTCInformation                0x19                        no                                                                 yes                           yes
  InputOutputControlByIdentifier    0x2F                        yes                                                                yes                           yes
  RoutineControl                    0x31                        yes                                                                yes                           yes
  --------------------------------- --------------------------- ------------------------------------------------------------------ ----------------------------- -----------------------------
